spec: DACS-1 v0.8 §6.3.4 RSC-1..RSC-10 authoritative revocation completeness
decisionModel: verifier-owned corrective-profile admission (exact release pin + complete module tuple, session- and identity-bound) precedes all listing interpretation; only a signed Listing whose finalized receipt and authenticated current-head non-membership share one authenticated finalized state admits a new session; verified inclusion or a superseding authenticated revocation fails as revoked; every incomplete/conflicting/provenance-mutated proof is indeterminate
inputModel: a signed Listing carrying its revocationState reference, a finalized listing receipt, exact signed heads/markers, sparse proofs, binding-self-authenticated finalized receipts, key-authority results, and binding-authenticated current-state context whose signature binds the listing, the head, and the complete conflict-observation set

testBinding.note: This deterministic signed-current-value adapter does not claim a deployed Demos capability.

vectors.name: rsc-valid-active-nonmembership
vectors.note: an exact empty-leaf proof against the authenticated current head admits a new session

vectors.name: rsc-valid-genesis-absent
vectors.note: a transition-free genesis head with an explicit empty marker set and an exact empty-leaf proof admits a new session

vectors.name: rsc-valid-revocation-inclusion
vectors.note: an exact inclusion proof and marker refuse the revoked listing

vectors.name: rsc-censored-tombstone
vectors.note: an active discovery row cannot hide a revocation committed by the current head

vectors.name: rsc-stale-signed-head
vectors.note: a valid old signed head is not the current finalized native value

vectors.name: rsc-two-equivocated-heads
vectors.note: two valid children of one head at one sequence block selection

vectors.name: rsc-invalid-nonmembership
vectors.note: a sibling mutation cannot establish the signed root

vectors.name: rsc-latest-proof-unavailable
vectors.note: a finalized head without authenticated latest-state evidence is incomplete

vectors.name: rsc-cross-tuple-proof-replay
vectors.note: another listing tuple's proof cannot establish this listing

vectors.name: rsc-revocation-marker-unresolved
vectors.note: a committed leaf without an independently resolvable marker fails closed

vectors.name: rsc-rollback-below-listing-checkpoint
vectors.note: the current view cannot move behind the checkpoint signed into the listing

vectors.name: rsc-unauthorized-rotation-key
vectors.note: a cryptographically valid head from an unauthorized key has no seller authority

vectors.name: rsc-authorized-rotation-key
vectors.note: an authenticated rotated seller key may append an exact revocation through the RSC inclusion path

vectors.name: rsc-rotated-key-corrupted-signature
vectors.note: a rotated marker whose signature does not verify fails closed

vectors.name: rsc-wrong-signer-key
vectors.note: a marker signed by a key other than the authenticated authority key fails closed

vectors.name: rsc-wrong-signature-algorithm
vectors.note: a marker declaring an unsupported algorithm is unverifiable

vectors.name: rsc-higher-known-head-revokes
vectors.note: an authenticated later head that revokes the target supersedes a stale absent read

vectors.name: rsc-downgrade-without-profile-admission
vectors.note: a current-profile Listing without the authenticated corrective-profile admission cannot start a new session

vectors.name: rsc-profile-admission-release-mismatch
vectors.note: a different release pin refuses the session before listing validation

vectors.name: rsc-profile-admission-module-mismatch
vectors.note: a different module tuple refuses the session before listing validation

vectors.name: rsc-profile-admission-module-incomplete
vectors.note: a partial module tuple refuses the session before listing validation

vectors.name: rsc-profile-admission-session-mismatch
vectors.note: a session mismatch refuses the session before listing validation

vectors.name: rsc-profile-admission-identity-mismatch
vectors.note: an identity mismatch refuses the session before listing validation

vectors.name: rsc-profile-admission-unauthenticated
vectors.note: unauthenticated admission evidence refuses the session before listing validation

vectors.name: rsc-profile-admission-caller-copy
vectors.note: a caller-supplied profile copy has no admission authority

vectors.name: rsc-conflict-evidence-omitted
vectors.note: omitting the signed conflict-observation set is indeterminate, never absent

vectors.name: rsc-conflict-evidence-tampered
vectors.note: a substituted conflict-observation set is indeterminate, never absent

vectors.name: rsc-listing-receipt-missing
vectors.note: a current check without a finalized listing receipt is not one authenticated state

vectors.name: rsc-listing-receipt-stale
vectors.note: a listing receipt outside the shared finalized state is indeterminate

vectors.name: rsc-listing-receipt-tampered
vectors.note: a listing receipt whose tuple hash does not match the listing is indeterminate

vectors.name: rsc-historical-listing-without-state-ref
vectors.note: an old listing remains audit-readable but cannot enter the current new-session profile

vectors.name: rsc-checkpoint-history-gap
vectors.note: a later head cannot substitute for the complete checkpoint chain

vectors.name: rsc-producer-time-cannot-prove-latest
vectors.note: producer time cannot replace an authenticated current-state policy

vectors.name: rsc-rb4-discovered-marker-precedes-nonmembership
vectors.note: a verified discovered marker cannot be ignored even when the state proof says absent

vectors.name: rsc-rb5-indeterminate-precedes-nonmembership
vectors.note: an unresolved discovered revocation record prevents state non-membership from returning absent

vectors.name: rsc-conflict-later-rewrite
vectors.note: a later authenticated head that rewrites the target via a cross-tuple transition substitution is indeterminate, never revoked

vectors.name: rsc-conflict-removal-transition
vectors.note: a later authenticated head whose root removes the appended revocation leaf is indeterminate, never absent
